# Vesla — Custom Cosmetic Glass Packaging Manufacturer for Indie Beauty Brands

Vesla Co., Ltd. is a cosmetic glass packaging manufacturer based in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. We specialize in custom dropper bottles, cream jars, essential oil bottles, and glass vials for indie and emerging beauty brands across Europe and North America. Low MOQ from 5,000 pcs on stock molds. In-house decoration, DDP shipping to EU & USA.

## Quick Reference

- **Company**: Vesla Co., Ltd.
- **Location**: Guangzhou, Guangdong, China
- **Products**: Dropper Bottles, Cream Jars, Essential Oil Bottles, Glass Vials, Cosmetic Sets
- **MOQ**: 5,000 pcs (stock molds) / 10,000 pcs (private molds)
- **Sample**: Free sample kit for new brands, 5-7 business days DHL Express
- **Production**: 20-25 days after sample approval
- **Decoration**: Silkscreen, hot stamping, frosting, spray coating (solid + gradient), electroplating, water transfer printing
- **Shipping**: EXW, FOB, DDP to EU (Rotterdam / Hamburg) and USA (Los Angeles / Long Beach)
- **DDP Timeline**: 20-26 days door-to-door (14-18d sea + 3-5d customs + 2-3d trucking)
- **Email**: [info@veslapack.com](mailto:info@veslapack.com) / [yitengglass3@gmail.com](mailto:yitengglass3@gmail.com)
- **WhatsApp**: [+86 18165681131](https://wa.me/8618165681131)
- **Address**: 11th Floor, Building 5, Baiyun Financial Holdings Intelligent Connected Vehicle Industrial Park, No. 66-4 Zhihong Road, Jianggao Town, Baiyun District, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China

## Factory & Quality

- 6 IS forming machines, 32,000 m² facility, 280+ staff
- Annual capacity: 60 million units
- ISO 9001:2015 certified
- Materials: Type III soda-lime glass, compliant with FDA 21 CFR, EU 1935/2004, REACH & RoHS
- SGS audited facility
- AQL 1.5/2.5/4.0 sampling inspection; third-party inspection welcomed
- Glass cullet recycling rate above 92%

## Product Categories

- [Dropper Bottles](https://www.veslapack.com/products?category=dropper): 5ml - 100ml, frosted / clear / amber / violet / matte black glass. Gold, silver or matte black collar. Compatible with straight and push-button droppers.
- [Cream Jars](https://www.veslapack.com/products?category=jar): 15g - 120g, frosted / clear / matte glass. Woodgrain water-transfer lids, double-wall construction, wide mouth.
- [Essential Oil & Vials](https://www.veslapack.com/products?category=oil): 2ml - 30ml, amber / violet / euro round glass. Roll-on, vial, dropper options. UV-protective.
- [Cosmetic Sets](https://www.veslapack.com/products?category=set): Coordinated bottle + jar collections with matching gradient finishes. Turnkey single-brand identity.

## FAQ Summary

1. **MOQ**: 5,000 pcs stock molds; custom molds from 10,000 pcs
2. **Samples**: Free sample kit, 5-7 business days DHL Express
3. **Customization**: OEM/ODM — custom molds, Pantone colors, silkscreen, hot stamping, frosting
4. **Lead time**: 20-25 days bulk production after sample approval
5. **Certifications**: ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR, EU 1935/2004, REACH & RoHS, SGS audited
6. **Shipping**: EXW / FOB / DDP to EU and USA
7. **DDP USA**: 20-26 calendar days door-to-door
8. **Payment**: 30% deposit, 70% against shipping documents
9. **EU Compliance**: Type III soda-lime glass complies with EU 1935/2004; ISO 17025-accredited test reports included
10. **Gradient/Pantone**: Custom Pantone coating and gradient spray options available
11. **Coordinated sets**: Turnkey sets with consistent finish across bottles, jars and boxes
12. **Quote process**: Send product model, target quantity, logo file, packaging request, certification requirement and destination country — reply within 24 hours
